changes: First tagged release of BookmarkRanger, a self-hosted manager for bookmarks and code snippets.
Bookmarks: boards and categories that switch without a page reload, drag-and-drop and up/down reordering with custom sorting, and one dialog for renaming, deleting and reordering.
Snippets: tags, search, sorting by created/updated/name, syntax highlighting, and copying the code or a raw-text URL.
Dashboard: pinned categories, links and snippets, groups for pinned links, and an optional greeting with date, time and current weather (via Open-Meteo, no API key required).
Sharing: publish boards, categories and snippets to any number of named public pages, each with its own URL and no login required to view.
Favicons are looked up from each site's own declared icon and hotlinked from that site instead of being stored locally.
Settings: 16 color themes plus custom themes, German and English per account, on-demand database backups, and this changelog.
Docker image published via GitHub Actions, docker-compose file and Unraid template.
